name: Teabud · Gremlet #41
description:
A tea-leaf bud from a misty hillside garden. Quiet, calm, and slightly fragrant.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Teabud in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
